name: x3d-stem-living-heart/v1
purpose: Living Heart (x3d.STEM flagship 5). Accepting under it means: the scene is grammatical and meaningful on the fork with no known trap; every case declares its model and limits; the solver converges to the exact Nagumo front speed at second order and a resting mode decays at the exact discrete rate; conduction, spiral and scroll-wave periods are consistent and stable under refinement; the no-flux walls conserve exactly; payloads inflate to their recorded bytes; the builder and solver are the shipped ones; and a browser matched the builder's excited-cell counts on every frame, meshed the wall to the builder's reference, and played through the scene's own route.
limitations: Page traps are static pattern and syntax checks of src/*.js against the X_ITE contracts the Loom has paid for (law 32); the page's browser evidence remains the behaviour witness.
Behaviour is one headless Chromium on one machine: counts, mesh and playback order, not pixels or frame rate.
The 3D scroll wave was seeded from a computed 2D spiral (stated in its manifest).
The shared library lib/stemkit lies outside the candidate; its hashes are recorded but not gated.
Grammar and Meaning ran on the local x3d_mcp fork checkout, not the family pin.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
